name: Hỏa xung tầng
desc: a burning punch: rays rush into an orb at the fist, a spiky white flash fuses with a white-hot beam, a dark-red ring stands around the fist, and four tiers of broken calligraphic fire rings fly out with a faint pressure front ahead; the first ring travels farthest and grows widest, every ring cools, fades and breaks into hooks and chips, while bright tracers with arrow heads, sparks and rising embers scatter forward
